title: Talking to Lys at The Rope Larder (right after peacefully resolving Rook) offered 'tell her to go to him himself' and 'call her brother a deserter' — dialogue that reads as belonging to the earlier Cal/Camp Gallows conversation, not the scene we were actually in (standing next to Rook).
